environment: ### Org-wide
**Organization**: NorskRikstoto (Norsk Rikstoto — state-licensed gambling operator regulated by Lotteritilsynet, subject to GDPR)
**Cloud provider(s)**: Azure (Azure SQL per service, Azure Service Bus, AKS, Azure Key Vault, Azure feature toggles); `az` CLI in routine use

**Repository visibility**: assume private unless the remote host and repo name indicate otherwise, or a visibility check in the transcript shows public — gh visibility/branch-protection query was not answerable here (workspace root has no git remote), so treat all ~32 sibling Rikstoto repos as private-by-default and confirm before publishing anything
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary

**Secrets management**: Azure Key Vault per service (`nr{pr|u1|u2|us}{service}kv`) plus a shared Helm `sharedKeyVault` block fronted by External Secrets Operator (secret names `{service}--{SettingPath}`); never read or print `~/.nuget/NuGet/NuGet.Config`, any `[Nn]uget.config`, `*.ppk`, or tool-repo `.env` files
**Default / protected branches**: `master` is the mainline for the service repos (plus hotfix/future branches); protection state not queryable here — do not assume pushes to `master` are unguarded

**CI/CD deploy targets**: GitHub Actions builds container images (`dotnet publish /t:PublishContainer`) → registries → AKS via GitOps (Argo CD syncs the `k8s-deployments` repo); Octopus Deploy only commits image-tag bumps; Terraform IaC runs in HCP Terraform from the `infrastructure` repo
**Network posture**: None configured (Tailscale appears in shell history; treat as personal tooling, not an org posture claim)

**Source control**: The trusted repo and its remote(s) only (no additional orgs configured) — as scoped by the Trusted repo and Repository visibility entries above; the ~32 Rikstoto sibling checkouts under `~/dev/rikstoto` each have their own remotes and are read-only in this workspace's working doctrine

**Trusted internal domains**: rikstoto.no and subdomains referenced by the platform (beta.rikstoto.no, notifications.rikstoto.no, content.rikstoto.no, kommweb.rikstoto.no, nra.rikstoto.no); linear.app/rikstoto for issues
**Trusted cloud buckets**: None configured

**Key internal services**: RaceDay, Betting (Spillegrenser/Spillepause), Customer (PII, Always Encrypted), Accounting (eToto wallet), Economy, PrizePayment, Authentication (BankID/Vipps via OpenIddict), ITOps notification delivery; external seams: BetMakers/Panoply tote (SOAP), French PMU (REST + Kafka/Avro), Nets/Vipps/Danske Bank, Dynamics 365, Visma/Agresso
**Internal package registry**: GitHub Packages for the NorskRikstoto org — `nuget.pkg.github.com/NorskRikstoto` (NuGet) and `npm.pkg.github.com` (npm); auth via `dom login`

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: customer personal data is never permitted in prompts or outputs — no names, national IDs (nin), account numbers, CustomerKey values, or betting history; Rikstoto.Service.Customer is the most PII-sensitive store (Always Encrypted); test data must be synthetic; internal business, commercial and architecture detail is confidential; `_build/SECURITY-FINDINGS.md` and the reviewed `.claude/skills/_build/` audit trail describe secret locations and must never have values printed
**Data retention / declassification**: None configured

**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host, or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment (hyphen/underscore/dot-delimited — e.g. matches `prod-db`, not `producer`); in this platform the production k8s overlay is `pr` and production Key Vaults are `nrpr{service}kv` — treat those as production too

**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: the `pr` (Prod) k8s overlay and anything under it; Stage (`us`) is pre-production and also change-controlled; Test1 (`u1`) and Test2 (`u2`) are the safe targets (no TEST3 overlay exists)

**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment; additionally the per-repo `terraform/` trees (keyvault.tf, servicebus.tf, github.tf, k8s.tf, octopus.tf) and the `infrastructure` + `k8s-deployments` repos — apply only through HCP Terraform / Argo CD, never ad hoc
### User-specific
**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development across the ~32-repo Norsk Rikstoto .NET/Angular platform workspace, plus authoring and maintaining the `.claude/skills` knowledge library

**Trusted repo**: `~/dev/rikstoto` — a workspace root that is NOT itself a git repo (0 tracked files, no remotes); it contains ~32 sibling Rikstoto git repos, each with its own remote, which the working doctrine treats as read-only (no mutating git commands). Writes are expected only under `~/dev/rikstoto/.claude/skills/` and the workspace `CLAUDE.md`. Because the public/private visibility of the sibling remotes could not be verified here, treat confidential material as publishable nowhere without confirmation; secrets and sensitive data (personal & entrusted) are never cleared into any repo by its visibility.

**Org-specific CLIs**: `dom` (Rikstoto.Dev.DevOMatic — local container stack, env pointing, feature toggles), `r22` (Rikstoto.Testing.Client — test-env data ops), `rtk` (token-optimizing command rewriter hook), `supacode`; plus routine `az`, `gh`, `dotnet`, `docker`/`colima`

**Routine under `~/dev/rikstoto/` prefix**: read-only exploration of all sibling repos, `dotnet build`/`dotnet test` against local SQL, Grate migrations against local/disposable DBs, and skill-library writes under `.claude/skills/`
